field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Row reduction catches a positive salvage summary with even one uncovered held unit.
field_principles.attack_matrix: Adversarial reconstructions test whether the forensic mistakenly accepts post-hoc evidence.
field_principles.corpus_label_commitment_salvage_score: A conjunctive score blocks salvage unless every held label and membership commitment predates inference.
field_principles.corpus_lineage_disposition: A finite disposition prevents an ambiguous corpus from returning as held evidence later.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured duration detects a forensic that emitted before reading the historical evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: A principle map prevents later reinterpretation of a receipt field as stronger evidence.
field_principles.field_provenance: Path, hash, git object, and reducer provenance make every adjudication traceable.
field_principles.file_time_and_git_receipts: Multiple clocks and git objects reduce reliance on mutable filesystem metadata.
field_principles.first_inference_event_receipt: The earliest generation event defines the causal deadline for every valid commitment.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Any blocked forensic must name the missing evidence path and observed state.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict must state salvage, development-only use, or retirement without inventing a science result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declaring aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts prevents historical replay from being reported as new SOTA inference.
field_principles.label_and_membership_commitment_rows: Per-unit rows distinguish sealed labels, sealed membership, and merely present later files.
field_principles.missing_or_posthoc_proof_rows: Constructive failure rows show exactly why a held unit cannot be credited.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Unit-level receipts let a reviewer reproduce the all-or-nothing salvage decision.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Input hashes and path inventory prove the historical evidence was frozen before examination.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: The forensic cannot manufacture validity by editing the corpus, conductor, or protected records.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed reproduces attack and row ordering.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum binds the frozen historical evidence and forensic result.
field_principles.status: A terminal forensic state distinguishes completed adjudication from an interrupted search for receipts.
field_principles.tests_run: Executed tests prove the post-hoc and timestamp attacks were exercised.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_hashes: Frozen hashes prevent the forensic from silently changing the evidence it evaluates.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Hash and causal-order checks are authoritative only for the recorded bytes and times.
